name: Scorched Innocence
source:
After graduating high school, 18-year-old Emily wanted nothing more than a quiet summer. Instead, a fire destroys her home and leaves her and her mother with nowhere else to turn. Her mother’s boss, a wealthy and isolated man named Charles, offers them shelter in his large estate in exchange for help keeping the place in order. The arrangement seems simple at first—until Emily begins to realize that the fire, their sudden homelessness, and Charles’s “generosity” may not have been accidents at all.

Charles has watched her for years. As Emily's body matured, a quiet fixation hardened into something colder and more deliberate. Debt, carefully cultivated obligations, and the slow corruption of her mother’s loyalty and maternal love become the instruments by which he draws them both deeper into his home. What presents itself as refuge reveals, layer by layer, the shape of a cage.

Beyond the estate the world proves no kinder. Work demands its own prices, and the men who notice Emily see only youth, inexperience, and the possibility of taking what has not yet been claimed. Every attempt at escape seems only to tighten the circle around her.

The player shapes the manner of Emily's unraveling—the pace at which resistance yields, the means by which her virginity is taken, the degree to which blackmail, coercion, prostitution, voyeurism, and more intimate violations strip her of agency. 

In the end, it is not a matter of whether her innocence will survive the summer, but how completely it will be scorched. And what, if anything, will remain when the fire has finished its work.
translation:
高中毕业后，18岁的艾米莉原本只盼着度过一个宁静的暑假。谁知一场大火烧毁了她的家，令她与母亲走投无路。母亲的上司——富有而离群索居的男人查尔斯向母女俩敞开了自家庞大的庄园，条件是帮忙打理宅邸事务。起初这桩安排看似简单明了——直到艾米莉渐渐察觉，那场火灾、母女俩突如其来的流离失所，乃至查尔斯的“慷慨解囊”，或许从头到尾都不是什么意外。

查尔斯已在暗中窥视她多年。随着艾米莉的身体日渐成熟，那份隐秘的执念逐渐凝固为更加冷酷、蓄谋已久的算计。债务、精心编织的人情枷锁，以及对她母亲忠诚与母爱的慢性腐蚀，都成了他将母女二人步步拽入宅邸深处的工具。看似庇护所的庄园，正一层层显露出囚笼的轮廓。

而在庄园之外，这个世界同样毫无善意可言。工作索取着各自的代价，注意到艾米莉的男人们眼中只看得到她的青春、涉世未深，以及采撷那朵尚未被人染指之花的可能。每一次逃离的尝试，似乎都只是将她周遭的罗网收得更紧。

玩家将亲手决定艾米莉一步步沉沦的方式——她反抗瓦解的快慢、贞洁被夺走的途径，以及勒索、胁迫、卖身、偷窥乃至更深层侵犯剥夺她自主意志的程度。

归根结底，问题早已不是她的纯真能否熬过这个夏天，而是它将被焚毁得何等彻底——以及当烈火燃尽之后，究竟还会留下些什么。
